description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single attacks (1.50 each), grants [Conditional Attach Element with Stacking From Party], [Awoken Archive Master], [Damage Cap +10000] and [Archive Authority Mode] to the user

description.name: Conditional Attach Element with Stacking From Party
description.text: Grants [Attach Fire with Stacking]/[Attach Ice with Stacking]/[Attach Lightning with Stacking]/[Attach Earth with Stacking]/[Attach Wind with Stacking]/[Attach Water with Stacking]/[Attach Holy with Stacking]/[Attach Dark with Stacking]/[Attach Poison with Stacking] if current number of combined Attach Element statuses on party members are a majority Attach Fire/Ice/Lightning/Earth/Wind/Water/Holy/Dark/Poison. In the case of ties the prior listed order is used to determine status granted

description.name: Awoken Archive Master
description.text: Black Magic and Summoning abilities don't consume uses and deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Black Magic and Summoning abilities trigger 1 additional time

description.name: Archive Authority Mode
description.text: Instant cast speed for Black Magic and Summoning abilities, casts Magical Surfing after using a Black Magic or Summoning ability, removed after triggering three times
